d: A major showdown has taken place at the United Nations. The Cuban delegation confronted the US ambassador to the UN, Mike Waltz, over his disrespectful comments about the country, and former leader, Fidel Castro. The faceoff led to the UN session getting suspended. Firstpost takes a closer look at the fight between the US and Cuba. Gursshheenkaur Gahllen explains what Washington has been doing to Havana over the years, and unpacks the US embargo on Cuba, US president Donald Trump's current fuel blockade, and the possibility of the US invading the Caribbean island nation.
